content:
rachael: Quick check — planning the EU->NA cutover for tenant residency window tomorrow. want a short runbook for the edge/quorum parts before we hand to oncall. :clipboard:

matt: +1. do we still follow lease-swap then soft-evict pattern? last time we saw a 60s spike on fallback requests.

jyoti: Yes, lease-swap -> prewarm standby -> drain. but add a pre-cutover KV snapshot and a consent flag check. if consent=false, abort.

sam: Real-world checklist I'd run:
- verify consent matrix (legal flag) for tenants in scope
- ensure kv-snapshot uploaded to region-bucket
- ensure standby nodes prewarmed with model weights and KV snapshots
- open canary to 1% traffic, watch 5xx and p50/p95

rachael: here's a compact sequence we can copy into the runbook: 
```
1) run `scripts/kv_snapshot --tenants file.csv --upload s3://eu-cutover-archives/$TS`
2) flip feature flag `infra toggle residency-cutover --region na --tenants-file file.csv` (staged)
3) enable prewarm on standby pools: `PATCH /api/pools/standby?action=prewarm&tenants=@file.csv`
4) canary 1% traffic for 10m, monitor `errors>0.5%` or `p95>200ms` => rollback
5) drain primary via lease-swap; wait for leases=0
6) switch routing header `X-Resident-Region` to NA and promote standby to primary
7) post-cutover KV-validate and telemetry smoke tests
```
(we should script 1/2/3)

matt: In step 5, what do we mean by "wait for leases=0"? do we rely on controller aggregation or check per-proxy?

jyoti: controller aggregation only. add a safety TTL: if leases don't drop in 3m, auto-fallback policy triggers and we abort cutover. That avoids split-brain attempts during noisy network.

sam: add an additional heuristic: if inflight-requests > 1000 for any tenant after step 2, hold canary. we saw queueing cascade last quarter.

rachael: Good call. Also add consent propagation check: the routing layer needs a read of the consent stamp TTL before we flip. if stamp_age > 24h, fail.

infra-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout scheduled at 2026-03-22T14:00Z by rachael. Tracking ID: deploy-4765432-canary.

matt: We need explicit rollback commands in the playbook. e.g.:
```
# rollback
infra toggle residency-cutover --region na --revert true
PATCH /api/pools/standby?action=drain&tenants=@file.csv
# restore routing header back to EU
update-router --set X-Resident-Region=eu --apply
```

jyoti: Also add a data-sanity probe against embeddings/kv after cutover: sample 50 keys, compare checksums. If mismatch > 1%, alert SRE and revert.

rachael: Agreement: add thresholds as variables in the runbook (canary_percent, canary_duration_mins, error_threshold_percent, p95_threshold_ms, lease_ttl_mins, inflight_threshold). Keep defaults conservative.

sam: One more: telemetry tags. add `cutover_id` to all metrics and traces during the operation. that'll simplify dashboard filters.

rachael: I'll update the runbook doc and add a preflight script that runs the checks (consent, snapshot, prewarm, inflight). Anyone want to pair on the script review tomorrow morning?

matt: I can at 9:30.

jyoti: I'll do post-cutover validation tests and the checksum probe.

infra-bot: reminder: oncall rotation for 2026-03-22 08:00-20:00Z: matt (primary), sam (secondary).

rachael: Great. Action items:
- rachael: PR runbook + script (will include abort conditions)
- matt: review script @ 09:30
- jyoti: validation probes and thresholds
- sam: ensure monitoring dashboards include cutover_id panels

sam: :thumbsup: logging echo for playbook visibility: include `X-Cutover-ID` in all request logs so we can correlate request routing vs lease state.

rachael: Done. I'll push draft before EOD today. If anything else, call it out here. :eyes:
